page.layout: One page of running text; marginal notes in the right margin. The left edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Augustino, Episcopo Terraconensi animad-uersam, qui tamen errores Gratiani ex industria collegit: verum in corpore iu-ris Canonici iussu Gregorij 13. Pontificis Romani edito, illam epistolam {f}Gre-gorio 7. ascriptam, reperio, Sed vrgent aduersarij, Symachum saltem Gelasij successorem, hunc Imperatorem Ana-stasium excommunicasse; cum tamen {t}Euagrius (a quo haec suspitio defump-ta) tantum affirmat, nonnullos tan-quam Concilij Calcedonensis aduersarium illum e sacris Tabulis exemisse: Hye-rosolymis vero Anathema fuisse illi de-nunciatum. Addit {u}Nicephorus hoc fact-um cum adhuc superstes esset; {x}Marti-nus vero Polonus, & {y}Iohannes Marius hanc excommunicationem attribuunt Anastasio Papae; {z}Sabellicus, {a}Platina, & Ciaconius Gelasio, sed hęsitantèr & ti-mide, cū referuationibus: Sunt qui scri-bunt, ut tradunt quida. Antiquiores vero, Rhegino, Vrspergensis, Sigiberfus Frisingensis, Marcianus Scotus, Hermanus Contractus, Gotfridus Viterbiensis, de hui9 Imperatoris excommunicatione, ne syllaba quidem: imo ipse Symmachus in suo ad Anastasi-
{f} In Regi-stro lib.8. epist.21. Hermanno Episcopo mentensi.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin, keyed to the text marks f, t, u, x, y, z, a. The mark of 'hui' is a superscript sign printed after the word, rendered here as 9 and uncertain. The word 'hęsitantèr' is read with a grave accent that may be a printing feature. The catchword 'um' stands at the lower right. The note for 'Herimanco' is read as 'Hermanno Episcopo mentensi' and is doubtful in its last word. The reference to 'Ioan.' is not present on this page.
